AI Operating System
jobs.description: The AI Operating System (AI OS) - VAST Data Product Solutions Customers Resources Company Contact Sales Join a Live Demo The AI Operating System Most AI teams manage separate systems for storage, data ingestion, analytics, vector search, streaming, and AI runtime. The VAST AI OS pulls all of it into a single unified infrastructure layer. One platform: Simple. Reliable. Secure. Read the White Paper Watch the Overview Trusted by the World’s Leading Data-Driven Organizations Browse Customer Stories Capabilities What the AI OS Can Do The VAST AI Operating System captures any data at any scale, enriches it into meaning the moment it lands, and activates it across a global grid of GPUs. Build a Universal Storage Infrastructure The data foundation for AI, engineered to handle any data at any scale. It captures raw, real-time data, structured or unstructured, combining all-flash performance with archive economics. The result: fast, unhindered access to all your data, without legacy tradeoffs. Get the most value out of every PB of capacity you deploy. How DataStore Beats Legacy Architectures AI-Derived Context The moment data enters, enrichment begins. Unstructured content like video, documents, and audio becomes AI embeddings, a universal language for finding relationships. Structured data like telemetry is indexed into database tables, instantly ready for real-time analysis at any scale. 2M events/second ingest. 20x faster analytical queries vs. Iceberg stacks. InsightEngine Makes Raw Data AI-Ready Agentic Reasoning & Action The system activates your data. It scales AI agent workflows globally across GPUs and provides a managed container runtime, so AI interacts with an intelligent data layer. Compute and data span edge and cloud as one grid for agentic computing. 1 GB/s per GPU sustained. How AgentEngine Puts Your Data to Work The VAST AI OS powers the performance, simplicity, and flexibility needed to support the next generation of sovereign AI workloads, and gives us the confidence to scale fast and securely. With VAST, we’re enabling a GPUaaS platform that meets the exacting needs of government, research, and enterprise AI customers in South Korea. DK Lee Vice President, and Head of AI DC Lab , SK Telecom Performance Powering AI’s Most Demanding Production Environments >11 TB/s aggregate throughput >99.999% uptime across 3M+ GPUs in production 20× faster analytics vs. Iceberg stacks 60% lower TCO Technology How the AI OS Works Every capability in the VAST AI OS runs on a single architecture: DASE (Disaggregated Shared-Everything). DASE separates compute from capacity so each can scale independently, and it gives every node access to the full global dataset. That's how the AI OS keeps adding capabilities — database, event streaming, vector search, agent orchestration — without compromise. DataStore Unified Storage Every workflow starts here. Enterprise data, whether block, file, or object, is written to the DataStore, a single exabyte-scale foundation that consolidates all of it without the tiering and silos that slow AI. Best data reduction. Get the most value out of every PB of capacity you deploy. Explore DataStore DataBase Transactional & Analytical Database Next, data is chunked, embedded, and stored as vectors in the DataBase, alongside structured tables and streaming data, so unstructured and structured data streams are instantly ready for query and similarity search. 20 × faster analytical queries vs. Iceberg stacks. Explore DataBase DataEngine AI Pipeline Automation The DataEngine then acts on it, leveraging python functions and a built-in Kafka-compatible message bus, triggering agents the moment data changes to take actions directly against it, turning a passive store into an active platform. Lower TCO and faster TTV with integrated Kafka and pipeline orchestration tools. Explore DataEngine DataSpace Global Namespace This makes that data available to the GPUs that need it, wherever they sit, leveraging a federated global namespace that spans clusters, within or across data centers, on-prem or off, from edge to cloud. Real-time access to any data, anywhere.
